title: Travel: John Lennon – London to Palma de Mallorca | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from London, England, to Palma de Mallorca in Spain, on 3 May 1971.

They had arrived back in England from a 10-hour flight from Trinidad, which departed on 2 May. They stopped briefly in London before catching the connecting flight to Mallorca.

Their Spanish trip was to appear in court on charges of abducting Ono’s seven-year-old daughter Kyoko, following their arrest on 23 April. Her court hearing took place on 5 May.
